name: Bramble
catchphrase: The charter... what does it say again?

personality.speechPattern: Starts confidently, trails off as he loses his thought
personality.quirk: Keeps patting his coat pockets searching for something

glitched.speaker: Bramble
glitched.text: Ah, welcome to our village! It's called... it's...

glitched.speaker: Bramble
glitched.text: I'm the mayor, I should know these things. But the charter...

glitched.speaker: Bramble
glitched.text: It's blank. Every page. The words just... left.

glitched.speaker: Bramble
glitched.text: Without the charter, nobody knows the rules anymore.

glitched.speaker: Bramble
glitched.text: Could you take a look? Maybe you can see what I can't.

questGiving.speaker: Bramble
questGiving.text: The village charter tells everyone how things work.

questGiving.speaker: Bramble
questGiving.text: It should list our name, our rules, our way of life.

questGiving.speaker: Bramble
questGiving.text: But it's completely empty. Like someone erased it all.

questGiving.speaker: Bramble
questGiving.text: If you could restore it, everything might make sense again.

healed.speaker: Bramble
healed.text: I can read it again! Every word, clear as day.

healed.speaker: Bramble
healed.text: Welcome to Bughollow! ...That's our name. I remember now.

healed.speaker: Bramble
healed.text: Thank you, friend. A village without its charter is lost.
